finding: Repeated descent returns to the same wrong basin. Family 67935 is influential, but stays preferred in causal and later curve/family searches. Omitting it gives 4.453 km and fails remaining-data gates.
next_discriminator: A single wrong ID is not established. Test shared receiver/band calibration against family-specific orbit discrepancy using held whole time groups; preserve the evidence that rejects the omission.

finding: Phase reference does not close after 15 rounds; local curvature condition ratio is about 31. Family 62320 carries phase/orbit coefficients about 9.35/11.60 original prior units. Omitting it gives 1.060 km and passes the remaining-data checks. Rivals 67047 and 63571 depend on TLE/model assumptions; the deployed uniqueness guard rejects ambiguity.
next_discriminator: Strong localization of the conflict to this family, but no unique replacement established. Compare all three with a joint phase-position solve and independent receiver/time prediction.

finding: Family 59414 needs an orbital coefficient about 18.24 prior units. A single curve favors 68026 while the whole-family restricted fit favors 65829. ALGO07 admits 65829 through its identity guard but rejects the final paired fit. Omitting 59414 gives 2.133 km with failed remaining-data gates.
next_discriminator: Association and shared-model conflict. Inspect family consistency across receivers and the specific residual slopes/steps blocking 65829; do not accept a single-curve winner.

finding: Both leading audited identities (65376 and 59041) remain preferred with causal and later elements. Removing 65376 worsens error to 7.036 km. Removing 59041 gives 2.344 km but fails residual gates.
next_discriminator: Several families constrain incompatible directions under the current model. Family 59041 has a large orbital nuisance coefficient; assess shared versus family-specific discrepancy on retained witnesses.

finding: Family 57414 removal gives 1.424 km with remaining-data checks passing. Rival 58786 competes under causal elements, but the later whole-family comparison returns to 57414. The largest local influence, 61846, is useful: deleting it worsens error.
next_discriminator: 57414 is model-sensitive, not a proven bad ID. Test 57414/58786 with the full physical nuisance model and whole-group prediction.

finding: Family 59770 has phase/orbit coefficients about 12.67/12.93 prior units. Rival 63315 wins restricted curve/family comparisons in both TLE regimes, but needs substantial corrections and fails the diagnostic noise screen. Removing 59770 gives 0.597 km but violates remaining-data gates.
next_discriminator: A promising rival exists, but its physical adequacy and compatibility with other families are unproven. Test a shared correction for 63315 before any reassignment.

finding: High coverage and closed descent still give a biased solution. Removing 64724 gives 2.048 km; removing 57898 gives 1.733 km; both pass remaining-data checks. Initial leading identities 64724/66964 remain preferred across TLE regimes.
next_discriminator: More than one family influences the bias; high point coverage is not enough. Compare independent family predictions and uncertainty calibration rather than forcing more points into the fit.

finding: Removing 65875 gives 0.831 km but fails remaining-data gates. Removing 63952 gives 1.707 km and passes. Causal searches retain 65875/63952; later data make 67432 competitive with 65875.
next_discriminator: Two interacting families, with retrospective identity sensitivity. A later winner alone cannot authorize a causal reassignment.

finding: Removing family 60148 gives 0.602 km with remaining-data checks passing. Yet 60148 stays preferred with causal and later elements, and its audited curve passes the restricted residual-noise screen.
next_discriminator: Strong family influence without evidence of an obvious wrong ID. Prioritize whole-family predictive weighting and orbit/calibration discrepancy; a clean in-sample curve can still pull the position incorrectly.

finding: Regional restart and a wider phase prior barely change the result. Removing either leading family 67812 or 68323 worsens error; removing 66482 gives 1.845 km and passes remaining-data checks.
next_discriminator: A smaller distributed bias, not a demonstrated catastrophic mismatch. Validate 66482 across independent groups and retain the useful dominant families.
